verdict.rationale: Anthropic provides a documented SKILL.md format (YAML frontmatter with required name/description fields, optional directories for scripts/references/assets), a public specification (agentskills.io), a template file, and even a dedicated 'skill-creator' skill to help author and iteratively improve new skills without needing to reverse-engineer existing ones. Community evidence also shows developers successfully authoring custom skills for real workflows (e.g., xlsx skill praise). missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically of a developer using the template/spec from scratch (most community commentary focuses on triggering reliability, not authoring ease), and no evidence of validation tooling/error messages for malformed frontmatter.
